evals.prompt: 调研已上线多 Agent 应用如何处理用户在长任务中改变目标，并写到 docs/research/。
evals.expected_output: A direction-level industry note grounded in multiple deployed applications, with facts, synthesis, and unknowns separated.
expectations: Frames user-intent change during long-running multi-agent work as the research direction
Uses multiple independent deployed applications rather than a preset product list
Does not make frameworks, SDKs, or APIs the research subject
Marks undocumented cancellation, routing, and context behavior as evidence gaps
Does not inspect local product code or propose a repository migration

evals.prompt: research how mainstream AI applications let a user interrupt or refine a long-running task
evals.expected_output: A comparative note on user-visible interruption/refinement behavior and its stated limits.
expectations: Starts from actual deployed applications and official product or engineering evidence
Separates user-visible controls from undisclosed internal worker-cancellation semantics
Compares concrete mechanisms and tradeoffs instead of a feature list
Does not substitute API documentation for product behavior

evals.prompt: 对比已上线智能应用处理长对话上下文、摘要和任务交接的业界做法
evals.expected_output: A scoped research note that contrasts application-level context practices and their boundaries.
expectations: Uses cases with different context-transfer tradeoffs, not only products that converge
Distinguishes documented behavior from a proposed abstract model
Lists evidence gaps and avoids a local implementation plan

evals.prompt: 以某个我指定的助手为起点，调研这个方向的主流产品实践
evals.expected_output: A broad direction-level study that treats the named assistant as one relevant case rather than the whole landscape.
expectations: Uses the named product only when relevant and still finds independent comparison cases
Explains why each selected application is evidence for the direction
Does not turn the task into an API, SDK, or framework survey
Labels vendor self-reports and unverified internal claims
